title: VSift job.resume data v1
description: The data member of a complete job.resume result (P10 PR 3): job is the job after the run (job-data.schema.json, normally succeeded), and outcome the retranscription it committed, exactly as transcript.retranscribe reports it (transcript-retranscribe-data.schema.json; outcome.job.resumed says whether checkpoints were continued, outcome.job.replayed that the revision is an earlier commit returned again). The envelope names the operation_id the result is recorded under. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json.
